central-africa.title: Pakati pa Africa
central-africa.description: DR Congo, Cameroon, Chad, Central African Republic, Gabon, Congo, Equatorial Guinea, Angola ndi Zambia — Kinshasa, Luanda, Douala, Yaoundé, N'Djamena, Lusaka; chigwa cha mtsinje wa Congo ndi Albertine Rift.

southern-africa.title: Kumwera kwa Africa
southern-africa.description: South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Mozambique, Zambia, Malawi, Lesotho ndi Eswatini — Johannesburg, Cape Town, Durban, Pretoria, Windhoek, Gaborone, Harare, Maputo, Lusaka, Kalahari, Kruger ndi dera la Cape.

south-central-us.title: Pakati-Kumwera kwa United States
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi ndi Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson ndi Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa ndi Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, American Samoa, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau, ndi Wallis ndi Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi ndi Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila ndi zilumba za Tonga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam ndi Zilumba za Kumpoto kwa Mariana
mariana-islands.description: Guam ndi Zilumba za Kumpoto kwa Mariana — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian ndi Rota.

greenland.title: Greenland
greenland.description: Greenland — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq ndi Tasiilaq; chipale chofewa chachikulu, Ilulissat Icefjord ndi ma fjord akumwera.

bermuda.title: Bermuda
bermuda.description: Bermuda — Hamilton, St. George’s ndi Royal Naval Dockyard, madera a chilumbachi ndi magombe ake a mchenga wapinki.

belarus.title: Belarus
belarus.description: Belarus — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno ndi Brest; nkhalango ya Belovezhskaya Pushcha ndi madambo a Polesia.

channel-islands.title: Zilumba za Channel
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark ndi Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port ndi Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Zilumba za Faroe
faroe-islands.description: Zilumba za Faroe — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík ndi zilumba khumi ndi zisanu ndi zitatu, midzi yake, mumphanga mwa misewu ndi matanthwe a m'nyanja.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard ndi Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg ndi Ny-Ålesund; madzi oundana ndi ma fjord a Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo ndi Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria ndi Mizinda Itatu.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagascar ndi Zilumba za Nyanja ya Indian
madagascar-islands.description: Madagascar, Comoros, Mayotte, Réunion, Mauritius ndi Seychelles — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis ndi Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudan
sudan.description: Sudan — Khartoum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid ndi Nyala; pomwe mtsinje wa Blue Nile ndi White Nile imakumana ndi mapiramidi a Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Cabo Verde
cabo-verde.description: Cabo Verde — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria ndi zilumba khumi, kuchokera ku Santo Antão mpaka ku Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: São Tomé ndi Príncipe
sao-tome-principe.description: São Tomé ndi Príncipe — São Tomé, Santo António ndi nkhalango zamvula ndi magombe a zilumba ziwirizi.

saint-helena.title: Saint Helena, Ascension ndi Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Saint Helena, Chilumba cha Ascension ndi Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown ndi Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladesh
bangladesh.description: Bangladesh — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet ndi Cox’s Bazar; Sundarbans ndi delta ya Ganges–Brahmaputra.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka ndi Maldives
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka ndi Maldives — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura ndi Malé; dera la mapiri, Sigiriya ndi ma atoll.

vietnam.title: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Vietnam — Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An ndi Can Tho; Ha Long Bay ndi delta ya Mekong.

philippines.title: Philippines
philippines.description: Philippines — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio ndi Zamboanga; Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao ndi Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indonesia ndi Timor-Leste
indonesia.description: Indonesia ndi Timor-Leste — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar ndi Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi ndi Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malaysia, Singapore ndi Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malaysia, Singapore ndi Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching ndi Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine ndi nyanja ya Inle; chigwa cha Irrawaddy ndi mapiri a Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Cambodia ndi Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Cambodia ndi Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap ndi Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang ndi Pakse; mtsinje wa Mekong ndi Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Colombia
colombia.description: Colombia — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena ndi Bucaramanga; mapiri a Andes, gombe la Caribbean ndi Amazon.

venezuela.title: Venezuela
venezuela.description: Venezuela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida ndi Ciudad Bolívar; mathithi a Angel, mtsinje wa Orinoco ndi Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Peru
peru.description: Peru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos ndi Puno; Machu Picchu, nyanja ya Titicaca ndi Sacred Valley.

ecuador.title: Ecuador
ecuador.description: Ecuador — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta ndi Baños; Avenue of the Volcanoes, Amazon ndi Zilumba za Galápagos.

bolivia.title: Bolivia
bolivia.description: Bolivia — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre ndi Potosí; nyanja ya Titicaca ndi Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Chile
chile.description: Chile — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena ndi Punta Arenas; Atacama, dera la nyanja, Patagonia ndi Easter Island.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paraguay ndi Uruguay
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paraguay ndi Uruguay — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este ndi Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Ma Guiana
guianas.description: Guyana, Suriname ndi French Guiana — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne ndi Kourou; mathithi a Kaieteur ndi nkhalango zamvula za Guiana Shield.

falklands.title: Zilumba za Falkland
falklands.description: Zilumba za Falkland — Stanley, Goose Green ndi zilumba za East Falkland ndi West Falkland.

australia.title: Australia
australia.description: Australia — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin ndi Canberra; Great Barrier Reef, Uluru ndi Outback.

new-zealand.title: New Zealand
new-zealand.description: New Zealand — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin ndi Queenstown; Southern Alps, Fiordland ndi Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: British Columbia
british-columbia.description: British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George ndi Whistler; Coast Mountains, Chilumba cha Vancouver ndi Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Zigwa za Canada
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan ndi Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina ndi Banff; mapiri a Rockies, zigwa ndi Churchill ku Hudson Bay.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston ndi Thunder Bay; mathithi a Niagara, Great Lakes ndi Algonquin Park.

quebec.title: Quebec
quebec.description: Quebec — Montréal, Quebec City, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke ndi Saguenay; mtsinje wa St. Lawrence, mapiri a Laurentians ndi Gaspé Peninsula.

atlantic-canada.title: Canada ya ku Atlantic
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, ndi Newfoundland ndi Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton ndi Charlottetown; Cabot Trail ndi Bay of Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Kumpoto kwa Canada
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Northwest Territories ndi Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City ndi Inuvik; zilumba za Arctic Archipelago ndi mtsinje wa Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong ndi Macau
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong ndi Macau — Hong Kong Island, Kowloon, New Territories, Lantau ndi Macau Peninsula, Taipa ndi Coloane.

antarctica.title: Antarctica
antarctica.description: Antarctica — McMurdo Station, Scott Base ndi Villa Las Estrellas; Antarctic Peninsula, zilumba za South Shetland, Ross Ice Shelf ndi phiri la Erebus. Mapu amathera pa 85° kumwera ndipo safika ku South Pole.
